Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding notice required by the parks and recreation commission.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to notice required by the parks and recreationcommission; amending RCW 43.17.400 and 79A.05.179; and adding a newsection to chapter 79A.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.17.400 and 2007 c 62 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Disposition" means sales, exchanges, or other actionsresulting in a transfer of land ownership. (b) "State agencies" includes: (i) The department of natural resources established in chapter43.30 RCW; (ii) The department of fish and wildlife established in chapter43.300 RCW; (iii) The department of transportation established in chapter 47.01RCW; (iv) The parks and recreation commission established in chapter79A.05 RCW; and p. 1 HB 1704 (v) The department of ((general administration)) enterpriseservices established in this chapter. (2) State agencies proposing disposition of stateowned land mustprovide written notice of the proposed disposition to the legislativeauthorities of the counties, cities, and towns in which the land islocated at least sixty days before entering into the dispositionagreement. (3) In addition to the requirements of subsection (2) of thissection, the parks and recreation commission must provide writtennotice to any port district, park and recreation district, or othermunicipal corporation that is authorized to acquire or improve publicoutdoor recreation land in which the land is located at least sixtydays before entering into the disposition agreement. (4) The requirements of this section are in addition andsupplemental to other requirements of the laws of this state.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79A.05.179 and 2007 c 62 s 11 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Actions under this chapter are subject to the notificationrequirements of RCW 43.17.400. Any entity entitled to written noticemay request in writing to enter into negotiations with the commissionin regard to the proposed disposition of lands owned by the commission.The commission must respond to any request before entering into anydisposition agreement, if the request is received within thirty daysafter the notice is provided.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Before the commission may close or otherwise cease managementoperations in any state park for more than a consecutive twelvemonthperiod or for an unspecified period, the commission must providewritten notice to any public body in which the park is located withinsixty days of initiating the proposed action. Any public body entitledto notice may request to enter into negotiations with the commissionfor a management agreement regarding the park. The commission mustrespond to any request before initiating the proposed action, if therequest is received within thirty days after the notice is provided. HB 1704 p. 2 (2) Any management agreement entered into pursuant to this sectionmust require that, if the land is not used for outdoor recreationpurposes, management responsibilities revert to the commission. (3) For the purposes of this section, "public body" includes anycounty, city, town, port district, park and recreation district, orother municipal corporation that is authorized to acquire or improvepublic outdoor recreation land.
